en.summary: The CGT union and the Human Rights League filed a complaint with the Rights Defender regarding law enforcement's handling of student demonstrations.

en.title: France-Italy: first setback for Zidane's Blues, frustrating evening at the Stade de France
en.summary: France drew 1-1 against Italy on Friday in the third Nations League match at the Stade de France, failing to secure victory despite better control of the game.

en.title: France draws with Italy in Zinédine Zidane's first match as coach at the Stade de France
en.summary: France scored first but conceded an equalizer to Italy after a defensive error during a Nations League match on Friday, resulting in a draw in Zidane's home debut as national team coach.

en.summary: France drew with Italy in a Nations League match during Zinédine Zidane's first game as coach at home.

en.title: To "lower fuel prices", G7 countries will release "up to 100 million barrels" within four months, announces Emmanuel Macron
en.summary: G7 nations plan to release up to 100 million barrels of oil over four months to reduce fuel prices, with Donald Trump endorsing Europe's decision to tap strategic reserves.

stories.title: Blocages des lycéens : le jeune homme blessé à Tours a perdu l’usage d’un œil

en.title: High school blockades: young man injured in Tours has lost sight in one eye
en.summary: A young man was severely injured during student blockades protesting learning conditions in Tours. Students plan further action on October 6 after the government failed to propose concrete measures.

stories.title: Le jeune homme, blessé à Tours lors d'un blocage de lycée, a perdu l'usage d'un œil

en.title: Young man injured during high school blockade in Tours has lost sight in one eye
en.summary: A young man was injured during a high school blockade in Tours and has lost vision in one eye. The national police inspectorate is investigating the incident.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : l’adolescent de 16 ans blessé à Tours a perdu l'usage d'un œil

en.title: 16-year-old adolescent injured in Tours during high school blockade has lost sight in one eye
en.summary: A 16-year-old high school student hospitalized in Tours since Wednesday suffered injuries consistent with a less-lethal weapon discharge during a high school blockade.

stories.title: Sous pression de Donald Trump, le G7 annonce un déblocage de 100 millions de barils de pétrole

en.title: Under pressure from Donald Trump, the G7 announces the release of 100 million barrels of oil
en.summary: The G7 announced a release of 100 million barrels of oil following pressure from Donald Trump. The decision was driven by concerns about rising prices and a potential U.S. embargo on diesel exports.

stories.title: Brésil : à deux jours de la présidentielle, les États-Unis suspendent les services de leur ambassade pour raisons de sécurité

en.title: Brazil: two days before the presidential election, the United States suspends embassy services for security reasons
en.summary: The United States has suspended its embassy services in Brazil citing security concerns ahead of the presidential election. Donald Trump stated he is monitoring the election closely.

en.summary: Sabena Engineering, Belgium, and Ukraine have rejected reports from the Wall Street Journal claiming low availability of Ukrainian F-16 fighter jets due to extended maintenance delays.

en.summary: The government's 2027 budget targets 5.5 billion euros in pension savings. The report examines what measures retirees must accept to achieve these cost reductions.

stories.title: Les organisations lycéennes appellent à poursuivre la mobilisation faute « de mesures concrètes »

en.title: Student organizations call for continued mobilization due to lack of concrete measures
en.summary: High school and student organizations have rejected proposals from Education Minister Édouard Geffray, citing insufficient concrete measures to address their concerns.

stories.title: Emploi américain : pourquoi une statistique décevante a fait grimper les Bourses

en.title: US employment: why disappointing statistics boosted stock markets
en.summary: Weak September job creation of 29,000 versus 85,000 expected led investors to lower expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases, with oil decline reinforcing this outlook. France's bond spread with Germany hit its highest level since 2012.

stories.title: Airbus à pleine cadence à Toulouse pour livrer à Eutelsat les satellites de la constellation OneWeb

en.title: Airbus at full capacity in Toulouse to deliver OneWeb constellation satellites to Eutelsat
en.summary: Airbus has delivered a first batch of 32 next-generation OneWeb satellites to operator Eutelsat. The European manufacturer can now produce nearly one satellite per day using a semi-automated assembly line.
